title_en: Pilot Operation of the Graduation and Completion Status Check Program
summary: The Academic Affairs Office has opened a pilot version of a new program in which undergraduate and graduate students can check their graduation and completion status, starting 10 August 2026 (Monday) at 13:00. Students are asked to check their graduation, completion and thesis/achievement review status and results, and their diploma information, through the Student Services menu. Official operation is planned for Fall 2026 (during September).
applies_to: Undergraduate and graduate students. The notice gives separate menu paths for each group. It does not state any further limit, and it does not state that the check is mandatory; students are asked to take note and to check the listed items.

dates.what: Pilot operation of the graduation and completion status check program begins
Planned start of official operation of the program

conditions: The program is currently in pilot operation for service improvement; official operation is planned for Fall 2026 (during September).
Undergraduate and graduate students use different menu paths to access the program.
steps: Undergraduate students: Review the attached screen image for undergraduates ((Attachment 1) 학부생 화면.png); its content was not read for this translation.

Undergraduate students: Go to Student Services > Graduation > Graduation Application > Undergraduate Graduation Application and Status [학생서비스 > 졸업 > 졸업신청 > 학부졸업신청 및 현황], available from 10 August 2026, 13:00.
Undergraduate students: Check the progress status and results of graduation and completion for your major, and check your diploma (degree certificate) information.
Graduate students: Review the attached screen image for graduate students ((Attachment 2) 대학원생 화면.png); its content was not read for this translation.

Graduate students: Go to Student Services > Graduation > Thesis-Related > Thesis/Achievement Review Application and Completion Status [학생서비스 > 졸업 > 논문관련 > 논문/실적심사 신청 및 수료현황], available from 10 August 2026, 13:00.
Graduate students: Check the progress status and results of graduation, completion and thesis/achievement review for your major, and check your diploma (degree certificate) information.
translation:
Notice of Pilot Operation of the Graduation and Completion Status Check Program

To make it more convenient and accessible for students to manage their graduation and completion schedules, the Academic Affairs Office has developed a graduation and completion status check program and plans to begin official operation in the Fall 2026 semester (during September).

Accordingly, before official operation, a pilot operation will be held as follows to improve the service. Please take note.

A. Program start date and time: Monday, 10 August 2026, 13:00

B. Graduation and completion status check program
- (Undergraduate) Student Services > Graduation > Graduation Application > Undergraduate Graduation Application and Status [학생서비스 > 졸업 > 졸업신청 > 학부졸업신청 및 현황]
- (Graduate) Student Services > Graduation > Thesis-Related > Thesis/Achievement Review Application and Completion Status [학생서비스 > 졸업 > 논문관련 > 논문/실적심사 신청 및 수료현황]

C. Items to check
- Progress status and results of graduation, completion and thesis/achievement review, by major
- Diploma (degree certificate) information
